points.point: Where to find the built-in AI Agent to write a post
points.sentence: Post editor opens the in-app AI Agent. It is separate from an external assistant connected through MCP.

points.point: Customer is in Developer Platform view (only Overview, Logs, Posts)
points.sentence: Select Switch to Content Studio if you are in Developer Platform.

verdict.reason: The entry says to switch from Developer Platform to Content Studio and select Post editor, which opens the in-app AI Agent.
